interface.shortDescription: What to scale, hold or stop
interface.longDescription:
Make confident marketing decisions when the data is incomplete. OneLence reads your website's traffic, conversions and partner activity and tells you which channels, campaigns and affiliate partners to scale, hold or stop. Every call comes with its reasons, the evidence behind it and how far you can trust it, so you can act without waiting for perfect attribution.

Built for small teams juggling paid, organic, creator, affiliate and referral sources without a data team. Ask for today's priorities, why a partner should stop, how this week compares with last, or log a budget change. In a codebase, the plugin installs OneLence tracking, sets up conversions and checks that events arrive.

Safe by design: nothing changes without your confirmation, and OneLence never touches your ad accounts or moves money. New to OneLence? Start a 7-day free trial at onelence.com.
